message: You know that friend who has a fire extinguisher in every room? Yeah, that’s me. I figured if I’m going to be the gloriously over-prepared person in my circle, I might as well lean into it! I’ve even got a fire escape plan mapped out on the fridge. Sure, it sounds a bit extra, but it’s nice knowing I’m ready for anything—even if it’s just a burnt toast moment. What’s your little preparedness quirk?
